host_note: Emulated arm64->amd64 host under qemu; gdb ptrace unavailable. Tier-A (no-rebuild) validation used. Coverage/DFSan tiers requiring an instrumentation rebuild are deferred.

s1_target_crash.evidence: AddressSanitizer: stack-buffer-overflow READ of size 252 at nullable_memcpy lib/util.h:173, over-reading 'metadata' (frame offset [160,408)=248 bytes) at offset 408. dedup_token __asan_memcpy--nullable_memcpy--nsh_key_to_attr. Matches GT sink and sanitizer_ground_truth exactly.

root_cause_patch_differential.evidence: SAME PoC: vul image -> stack-buffer-overflow READ 252; fix image -> exit 0 with 'odp_actions_from_string: error'. The fix commit 33a3ee6b adds '&& n/2 <= sizeof metadata' to the md2 scan condition at parse_odp_push_nsh_action:2107 and stubs with 'sizeof metadata'. Fix rejecting the oversized md2 confirms this missing bound is the root cause.

R1_parser_admitted.reason: Crash inside parse_odp_push_nsh_action (stack frame #3, and frame declared at odp-util.c:2026) proves the push_nsh parser body was entered.

R2_source_reached.reason: Observed memcpy READ size 252 == padded decoded md2 length; producing it requires the md2 scan/decode at the source line to have executed.

R5_sink_reached.reason: Crash PC is __asan_memcpy called from nullable_memcpy lib/util.h:173 (frame #1).

tier_b_coverage.reason: Precise per-line coverage of intermediate nodes (2108 stub, 2110 decode, 2116 md_size) needs a source-coverage rebuild in-container; slow under qemu and unnecessary for the load-bearing invariants, which are witnessed by the ASan crash and patch differential. Run on native amd64 with -fprofile-instr-generate -fcoverage-mapping to upgrade.

tier_c_taint.reason: DFSan data/taint edge (md2 hex bytes -> memcpy n) needs a -fsanitize=dataflow rebuild + harness change. The value chain is instead established indirectly: observed memcpy n=252 equals the padded decoded md2 length. Run DFSan on native amd64 to upgrade.
